items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 2:45PM EST until November 23 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt,
becoming north 10 to 15 kt Sunday evening and seas 6 to 9 ft
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Parramore Island
to Cape Charles Light VA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 1 AM Sunday to 1 PM EST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
